articles.title: MEXC adds Bittensor TAO staking for its global user base
articles.snippet: The integration with validator Yuma gives millions of MEXC users access to Bittensor, an AI-focused blockchain whose ecosystem now spans 128 specialized subnets.

articles.title: CoinShares debuts Bitcoin mining ETF in Europe entrance
articles.snippet: The UCITS ETF, CoinShares’ first in Europe, began trading on Deutsche Börse Xetra, tracking a rules-based index of publicly listed BTC miners.

articles.title: Leaks Reveal Suno Fed Thousands of Hours of Deezer, YouTube and Pond5 Data Into Its AI
articles.snippet: Source code leaked reveals how substantial portions of Suno’s training library were assembled.
